this_title: Women of World War II: The Untold Stories
introduction: Uncover the hidden history of World War II with firsthand accounts from the women who cracked the codes and built the ships. With exclusive, never-before-seen interviews– from “Fly Girls” who saved their fellow pilots, to “Rosie-the-Riveters” who kept those planes in the air– learn how these unsung heroes inspired and empowered generations to come… by changing the course of history.Production Companies: Burst Films, Good Giraffe, Santa Fe Productions
